pictures.scene: Thomas Moran, The Grand Canyon of the Yellowstone — the great rock walls standing over the gorge with the falls dropping away between them, for the choirmaster of the sons of Korah, God is our refuge and strength
pictures.name: pd_moran_grand_canyon_of_the_yellowstone

pictures.scene: Ludolf Backhuysen, Ships in Distress off a Rocky Coast — the boats thrown about under the cliff with their sails torn and the sea breaking over them, an ever-present help in times of trouble, therefore we will not fear
pictures.name: pd_backhuysen_ships_in_distress_off_a_rocky_coast

pictures.scene: Joseph Wright of Derby, Vesuvius in Eruption — the fire running down the mountain into the bay under the moon, though the earth is transformed and the mountains are toppled
pictures.name: pd_wright_of_derby_vesuvius_in_eruption

pictures.scene: Gustave Courbet, The Wave — the breaker standing up green and black with the foam flung off its crest, into the depths of the seas, though their waters roar and foam
pictures.name: pd_courbet_the_wave

pictures.scene: J. M. W. Turner, Snow Storm – Steam-Boat off a Harbour's Mouth — the little steamer lost in the whirl of snow and spray, and the mountains quake in the surge, Selah
pictures.name: pd_turner_snow_storm_steam_boat_off_a_harbours_mouth

pictures.scene: John Constable, Salisbury Cathedral from the Meadows — the spire standing over the river and the meadows while the storm goes off behind it, there is a river whose streams delight the city of God, the holy place where the Most High dwells
pictures.name: pd_constable_salisbury_cathedral_from_the_meadows

pictures.scene: Emanuel de Witte, Interior of the Oude Kerk in Amsterdam during a Sermon — the congregation gathered under the white pillars with the preacher in the pulpit above them, God is within her she will not be moved, God will help her when morning dawns
pictures.name: pd_de_witte_interior_of_the_oude_kerk_amsterdam_during_a_sermon

pictures.scene: John Martin, The Destruction of Sodom and Gomorrah — the city going down under a roof of fire with its towers falling into the furnace, nations rage kingdoms crumble, the earth melts when He lifts His voice
pictures.name: pd_martin_the_destruction_of_sodom_and_gomorrah

pictures.scene: Jacob van Ruisdael, The Castle of Bentheim — the stronghold set on the top of its wooded rock above the village, the LORD of Hosts is with us, the God of Jacob is our fortress
pictures.name: pd_ruisdael_the_castle_of_bentheim

pictures.scene: Caspar David Friedrich, Wanderer above the Sea of Fog — the man standing on the summit rock looking out over the whole country under the mist, Selah, come see the works of the LORD
pictures.name: pd_friedrich_wanderer_above_the_sea_of_fog

pictures.scene: Jacob van Ruisdael, The Jewish Cemetery — the broken abbey and the tombs standing in the ruined ground under the storm, who brings devastation upon the earth, He makes wars to cease throughout the earth
pictures.name: pd_ruisdael_the_jewish_cemetery

pictures.scene: J. M. W. Turner, The Burning of the Houses of Lords and Commons — the parliament of the kingdom going up in flame over the river, He breaks the bow and shatters the spear, He burns the shields in the fire
pictures.name: pd_turner_the_burning_of_the_houses_of_lords_and_commons

pictures.scene: Caspar David Friedrich, Moonrise over the Sea — the watchers sitting still on the rock while the moon comes up over the water, be still and know that I am God, I will be exalted among the nations
pictures.name: pd_friedrich_moonrise_over_the_sea

pictures.scene: Frederic Edwin Church, The Andes of Ecuador — the sun standing over range behind range of mountains to the end of the world, I will be exalted over the earth, the LORD of Hosts is with us
pictures.name: pd_church_the_andes_of_ecuador

pictures.scene: Thomas Cole, The Departure — the castle standing high on its rock above the bridge and the riders going out from it, the God of Jacob is our fortress, Selah
pictures.name: pd_cole_the_departure

lines.text: For the choirmaster. Of the sons of Korah. According to Alamoth. A song.
God is our refuge and strength,
an ever-present help in times of trouble.
Therefore we will not fear,
though the earth is transformed
and the mountains are toppled
into the depths of the seas,
though their waters roar and foam
and the mountains quake in the surge.
Selah
There is a river whose streams delight the city of God,
the holy place where the Most High dwells.
God is within her; she will not be moved.
God will help her when morning dawns.
Nations rage, kingdoms crumble;
the earth melts when He lifts His voice.
The LORD of Hosts is with us;
the God of Jacob is our fortress.
Selah
Come, see the works of the LORD,
who brings devastation upon the earth.
He makes wars to cease throughout the earth;
He breaks the bow and shatters the spear;
He burns the shields in the fire.
“Be still and know that I am God;
I will be exalted among the nations,
I will be exalted over the earth.”
The LORD of Hosts is with us;
the God of Jacob is our fortress.
Selah
